description: Source code for a GUI scrollbar widget in the Wesnoth game project, including rendering, event handling, and size management.

classes.name: scrollbar
classes.description: A GUI scrollbar widget with rendering and event handling capabilities.

methods.name: scrollbar
methods.description: Constructor initializing scrollbar widget with default parameters.

methods.name: update_location
methods.description: Updates the position of scrollbar components based on a rectangle.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides or shows the scrollbar and its arrows.

methods.name: get_position
methods.description: Returns the current scrollbar grip position.

methods.name: get_max_position
methods.description: Returns the maximum grip position based on content size.

methods.name: set_position
methods.description: Sets the scrollbar grip position within valid bounds.

methods.name: adjust_position
methods.description: Adjusts the grip position relative to a target position.

methods.name: move_position
methods.description: Moves the grip position by a relative amount.

methods.name: set_shown_size
methods.description: Sets the visible size of the scrollbar grip.

methods.name: set_full_size
methods.description: Sets the total size of the scrollable content.

methods.name: set_scroll_rate
methods.description: Sets the rate at which the scrollbar moves.

methods.name: is_valid_height
methods.description: Checks if a given height is valid for the scrollbar.

methods.name: scroll_down
methods.description: Scrolls down by the scroll rate.

methods.name: scroll_up
methods.description: Scrolls up by the scroll rate.

methods.name: process_event
methods.description: Handles user input events for the scrollbar.

methods.name: groove_area
methods.description: Calculates the area of the scrollbar groove.

methods.name: grip_area
methods.description: Calculates the area of the scrollbar grip.

methods.name: draw_contents
methods.description: Renders the scrollbar, including groove and grip images.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Processes SDL events for interaction with the scrollbar.
